repo autolink list.--web: Opens repository autolink settings in a browser instead of listing via HTTP. The harness deliberately sets GH_BROWSER=false and cannot verify browser navigation. REST listing is exercised separately.

repo license view.--web: Opens the external choosealicense.com website in a browser, not the test-owned GHES server; the sweep must not access that network origin. License text and catalog paths are exercised without a browser.

repo view.--web: Launches a browser rather than rendering the repository. GH_BROWSER=false intentionally prevents this external side effect; text, branch and JSON paths are covered.

ruleset check.--web: Opens the branch rules web page in a browser; GH_BROWSER=false prevents browser side effects. Explicit/default branch API behavior is exercised without this flag.

ruleset list.--web: Opens the ruleset settings page in a browser rather than printing the API results. No browser is available in the headless harness; repo/org and inherited API paths are covered.

ruleset view.--web: Launches the ruleset web page in a browser, which the harness disables. Repository, organization and inherited ruleset details are asserted through the real gh API path.
